description: This header file defines a set of functions for 2D shape drawing in a graphics application, with Lua bindings for functions such as circle, ellipse, rect, square, line, arc, point, quad, triangle, and shape construction functions (beginShape, vertex, endShape). It includes documentation comments and example usage for each function.

methods.name: circle
methods.description: Draws a circle on the screen with specified center and diameter.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse on the screen with specified center and dimensions.

methods.name: rect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle on the screen with specified top-left corner and size.

methods.name: square
methods.description: Draws a square on the screen with specified top-left corner and size.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points.

methods.name: arc
methods.description: Draws an arc with specified ellipse center, size, and start/stop angles.

methods.name: point
methods.description: Draws a point at specified coordinates.

methods.name: quad
methods.description: Draws a quadrilateral with four specified vertices.

methods.name: triangle
methods.description: Draws a triangle with three specified vertices.

methods.name: beginShape
methods.description: Starts defining a custom shape, allowing vertices to be added.

methods.name: vertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to the current shape.

search-terms: specific functions for circle, ellipse, rect
